title: Listen and Choose a Response — Family

questions.stem: My mom is coming to stay with us for the weekend.

options.A: Then I'll clean the living room before she gets here.
options.B: My mom is a teacher in Ohio.

questions.explanation: Offering to prepare for the guest is a fitting response. The distractors switch to the listener's mom, change tense, or use the wrong pronoun.
questions.speaker: m6
